_note: native = a free first-party Shopify option that covers the basic version of this job. Always worded as 'check whether it covers what you use' — never as a guaranteed drop-in replacement.

email-sms.label: Email & SMS marketing
email-sms.native: Shopify Email covers basic newsletters and automated abandoned-cart emails

email.label: Email marketing
email.native: Shopify Email covers basic newsletters and automated abandoned-cart emails

popups.label: Pop-ups & signup forms
popups.native: Shopify Forms (free) handles email/SMS signup pop-ups

upsell.label: Upsells & cross-sells
upsell.native: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) adds complementary/related product recommendations

bundles.label: Product bundles
bundles.native: Shopify Bundles (free) handles fixed and multipack bundles

chat-helpdesk.label: Live chat & helpdesk
chat-helpdesk.native: Shopify Inbox (free) covers live chat and FAQ auto-replies

page-builder.label: Page builders
page-builder.native: Online Store 2.0 themes support drag-and-drop sections on every page

translation.label: Translation
translation.native: Shopify Translate & Adapt (free) translates the store into multiple languages

size-chart.label: Size charts
size-chart.native: A size chart can be a theme block or page with no app

order-tracking.label: Order tracking
order-tracking.native: Shopify's built-in order status page and Shop app show tracking

cookie-banner.label: Cookie consent
cookie-banner.native: Shopify's built-in customer privacy banner (Settings → Customer privacy)

returns.label: Returns & exchanges
returns.native: Shopify's built-in self-serve returns let customers request returns from their account

search.label: Site search
search.native: Shopify Search & Discovery (free) adds filters, synonyms and boosts

gift-cards.label: Gift cards
gift-cards.native: Shopify has built-in gift cards on every plan

dev-tools.label: Developer & feedback tools
dev-tools.leftover: is a website feedback tool for your team. It loads for every shopper too, which slows the store and can show your internal comment widget. Turn it on only while you are collecting feedback.

overlaps.note: Two email platforms — your email/SMS platform already sends newsletters, so the second email tool is usually redundant.
Your email platform also offers SMS. A dedicated SMS tool is a valid choice, but check whether you're paying for SMS in both.
Most email/SMS platforms include their own signup pop-ups — a separate pop-up app is often redundant.
All-in-one suites usually include bars, timers and badges already.
Many all-in-one suites include a reviews module — check whether you're paying for reviews twice.
All-in-one suites often include upsell/bundle widgets — check for duplicate widgets.
Yotpo widgets load alongside another reviews app. If you use Yotpo for reviews too, you are paying for reviews twice.
All-in-one suites usually include announcement & shipping bars already.
All-in-one suites usually include countdown & urgency timers already.
All-in-one suites usually include trust badges & icons already.
